AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.account_data_cell : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          ∀ (a b : ℕ),
            L.accountData w a = (s.accounts a).1 ∧
              L.accountLamports w a = (s.accounts a).2 ∧
                ((s.accounts a).1 = (s.accounts b).1 → L.accountData w a = L.accountData w b) ∧
                  (s.ownerLive a = Bool.true → L.accountData w a ≠ L.accountLamports w a)

      L.related w s → AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s → ∀ (c : ℕ), L.cellPayload w c = s.payload c

      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          ∀ (c : ℕ), L.cellCounter w c = s.counter c ∧ ∀ (t : ℕ), L.liveGuard w t = AspisR1.S2Trust.lookup s t
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.shared_ok : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (a t o : ℕ),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Enabled s (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.shared a t o) →
            0 ≤ s.counter (s.accounts a).1 →
              s.counter (s.accounts a).1 < AspisR1.S2Trust.maxCounter →
                AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.shared a t o)
                  (AspisR1.S2Trust.acquire s (s.accounts a).1 t o AspisR1.S2Trust.Kind.shared,
                    AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.guard t)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.shared_err : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (a t o : ℕ),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Enabled s (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.shared a t o) →
            s.counter (s.accounts a).1 < 0 ∨ s.counter (s.accounts a).1 = AspisR1.S2Trust.maxCounter →
              AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.shared a t o) (s, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.borrowFailed)

      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Enabled s (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.exclusive a t o) →
            s.counter (s.accounts a).1 = 0 →
              AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.exclusive a t o)
                (AspisR1.S2Trust.acquire s (s.accounts a).1 t o AspisR1.S2Trust.Kind.exclusive,
                  AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.guard t)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.exclusive_err : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (a t o : ℕ),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Enabled s (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.exclusive a t o) →
            s.counter (s.accounts a).1 ≠ 0 →
              AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.exclusive a t o) (s, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.borrowFailed)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.shared_deref : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (t : ℕ)
      (g : AspisR1.S2Trust.Guard),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.lookup s t = Option.some g →
            g.kind = AspisR1.S2Trust.Kind.shared →
              AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.deref t)
                (s, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.payload (s.payload g.cell))
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.exclusive_deref : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (t : ℕ)
      (g : AspisR1.S2Trust.Guard),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.lookup s t = Option.some g →
            g.kind = AspisR1.S2Trust.Kind.exclusive →
              AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.deref t)
                  (s, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.payload (s.payload g.cell)) ∧
                ∀ (i : ℕ) (v : UInt8),
                  i < (s.payload g.cell).descriptor.length →
                    AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.write t i v)
                      (AspisR1.S2Trust.writeAt s g i v, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.unit)

      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Enabled s (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.move t o) →
            AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.move t o)
              (AspisR1.S2Trust.relocate s t o, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.guard t)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.shared_drop : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (t : ℕ)
      (g : AspisR1.S2Trust.Guard),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.lookup s t = Option.some g →
            g.kind = AspisR1.S2Trust.Kind.shared →
              0 < s.counter g.cell →
                AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.drop t)
                  (AspisR1.S2Trust.release s g, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.unit)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.exclusive_drop : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (t : ℕ)
      (g : AspisR1.S2Trust.Guard),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.lookup s t = Option.some g →
            g.kind = AspisR1.S2Trust.Kind.exclusive →
              s.counter g.cell = -1 →
                AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w (AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.drop t)
                  (AspisR1.S2Trust.release s g, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.unit)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.error_move_drop : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w AspisR1.S2Trust.Op.errorMoveDrop (s, AspisR1.S2Trust.Reply.borrowFailed)

      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.Enabled s op → AspisR1.S2Trust.Matches L w op (AspisR1.S2Trust.run s op)
  AspisR1.S2Trust.S2TrustedSdkBorrow.guard_liveness : ∀ (w : W) (s : AspisR1.S2Trust.Heap F) (t : ℕ)
      (g : AspisR1.S2Trust.Guard),
      L.related w s →
        AspisR1.S2Trust.Valid s →
          AspisR1.S2Trust.lookup s t = Option.some g →
            L.liveGuard w t = Option.some g ∧
